text:
sophia: Quick heads up: planning a rolling maintenance in az3 tonight 02:30-04:00 UTC on the preemptible GPU cohort. Action plan: cordon -> drain -> reboot -> NIC microcode apply -> smoke test. We'll do nodes serially to keep disruption minimal.
aj: How many nodes and expected capacity hit?
sophia: 8 nodes in cohort, expect transient 7-12% available-GPU drop; sustained under 3% after warmbackfill. Each node ~12-15m end-to-end including healthchecks.
kevin: For latency-sensitive routes, can we wire a short-lived traffic-shift to the dedicated pool? Concerned about p95 tail during KV cache refill.
lia: Yes — plan: warm dedicated pool with KV seed before we start. Steps: 1) scale dedicated-pool +2 30m before; 2) run `python infra/tools/kv_seed.py --region az3 --target dedicated-pool` ; 3) set router fallback: `latency_threshold_ms:250`.
sophia: We'll also reduce batch concurrency for non-interactive jobs to avoid sudden backlog: patch cronjob `embeddings-batch` to `Forbid` during window. Lia can drive.
kevin: Routing rule snippet for ops runbook: `route { primary: interruptible, fallback: dedicated, fallback_if_latency_ms>250 }` — I'll validate that in staging.
night-oncall: I'm on-call and will watch dashboards. What are abort conditions?
sophia: Abort if: error-rate >1.5% for 5m, or p95 latency >500ms sustained 3m, or pod-evictions >2x baseline. Playbook has exact thresholds.
sre-bot: Reminder: run `preflight-check --cohort az3 --at 02:00Z` and attach results to this thread. Automated status will post at maintenance start to #status.
aj: Any tenants with pinned workloads we need to notify again?
sophia: Notified yesterday; there were two pinned tenants — we walked them through failover. Ops ticket #INF-842 attached.
lia: I'll prepare the k8s patch & rollback job: `kubectl patch cronjob embeddings-batch -n ml-jobs -p '{"spec":{"concurrencyPolicy":"Forbid"}}'` and a revert script to reapply original concurrency. Will test dry-run at 01:45Z.
kevin: Cost impact: backfilling to dedicated pool ~1.2 GPU-hours -> rough cost $45. Logged to cost-center `infra-maint`.
sophia: Timeline: 02:00Z preflight, 02:30Z start node 1, proceed serially every ~15m, expected finish ~04:00Z. Postcomplete: scale down dedicated after 30m stabilization and revert embeddings patch.
night-oncall: I'll keep PagerDuty open, will escalate to infra leads if any threshold trip.
sre-bot: Scheduled announcement set. Playbook link: https://confluence.internal/infra/az3-preemptible-maintain.
sophia: Thanks team. I'll post a 30m preflight update and pin this thread. :white_check_mark:
